Amazon is offering an excellent deal on a capable gaming laptop for Black Friday. For a limited time the Asus ROG Strix G16 RTX 5060 gaming laptop drops to $1,179.99 with free shipping after a 26% off instant discount. The RTX 5060 GPU has the maximum allowable TGP (115W), which means it will perform at the top of the pack compared to other RTX 5060 laptops. In fact, it's more powerful than the Steam Machine at a comparable price point.

26% Off Asus ROG Strix G16 RTX 5060 Gaming Laptop

The ASUS ROG Strix G16 gaming laptop features a 16" 1920x1200 165Hz IPS display, Intel Core i7-14650HX processor, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB NVMe SSD. It measures 0.9" thin and weighs about 5.8 pounds. It's not the lightest laptop on the block, but that's because the Strix models put more emphasis on maximum performance and cooling. The top lid boasts solid aluminum construction, but the base is made of plastic to keep the weight down and reduce heat transfer to the keyboard and palm area so that your hands don't get toasty while gaming.

The GeForce RTX 5060 (mobile) GPU is a good mid-range option for gaming

The RTX 5060 (mobile) offers solid gaming performance. It should run most games at 60fps on the display's 1900x1200 resolution especially if the game supports DLSS 4.5. Compared to the previous generation GPUs, it's basically a power efficient version of the RTX 4070. The RTX 5060 GPU found in the ASUS ROG Strix G16 features the maximum allowable TDP of 115W, which means it will perform at the top of the pack compared to other comparably equipped gaming laptops. To achieve this, the ROG Strix G16 employs an aggressive "ROG intelligent cooling" system that combines high-flow fans, vapor-chamber heatsink, and Conductonaut extreme liquid metal thermal interface.

This system is more powerful than the Steam Machine

The Intel Core i7 HX CPU and GeForce RTX 5060 mobile GPU outclasses the $1,049 Steam Machine, which is equipped with a very low wattage CPU and a custom GPU equivalent to the Radeon RX 7600 or GeForce RTX 4060. You're also getting a complete mobile platform that includes a built-in display, all for nearly the same price.
